translation_rules.rule: Preserve sequence, attempt, stage, actor role, correlation, causation and artifact references.
Store bytes unchanged, verify SHA-256 and retain source path as provenance metadata.
Import selected profile and reasons; platform policy may only require a stricter profile.
Map exact role IDs and intersect permissions with platform/workspace/repository policy.
Local checkpoint evidence is historical only and never grants new platform authority.
Import verdicts as evidence; Rigor Route independently validates before publication.

translation_rules.rigor_route: model runtime provenance and usage evidence
translation_rules.rule: Preserve selected target, adapter/model reference, locality, fallback reason and safe usage metrics; never treat local model choice as platform authority.
